sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **术语**：供应链攻击（Supply Chain Attack）。NIST 对风险管理的答案是 §1.5 的定义：「C-SCRM is the organized and purposeful management of cybersecurity risks throughout the supply chain」，§1.2 补充它是「an enterprise-wide activity that should be directed as such from a governance perspective」，并说明「supply chain refers to the linked set of resources and processes between and among multiple levels of an enterprise, each of which is an acquirer」。
statement.en: **Term**: Supply Chain Attack.It is registered under applied security engineering.

statement.zh: 范围之所以宽，是因为风险来自链条本身：§1 与 §2.2 把供应链网络安全风险描述为「the potential for harm or compromise that may arise from suppliers, their supply chains, their products, or their services」，§1.5 则把 C-SCRM 的活动划为「activities that span the entire SDLC, including research and development, design, manufacturing, acquisition, delivery, integration, operations and maintenance, disposal」。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in applied security engineering, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 方法采用多层风险管理：§2.3 引用 SP 800-39 的「three levels … 1) the enterprise level, 2) the mission and business process level, and 3) the operational level.C-SCRM requires the involvement of all three levels」，各级产出分别是整体策略与计划、中层策略与计划，以及系统级 C-SCRM 计划；§2.3.4 称「the CSCRM plan is a living document」。§1.6 说明本出版物把 SP 800-37 Rev.2 的框架加上 an enhanced overlay of specific C-SCRM controls, building on NIST SP 800-53 Rev.5。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 风险会沿链条下沉并汇聚：附录 G 要求在关键性分析中包含「critical fourth-party suppliers」，因为「an enterprise may find exposures to cybersecurity risks that result from third-party suppliers receiving critical input or services from a common fourth-party supplier」；控制 SR-3(2) 要求把控制「flow down this requirement to relevant sub-tier contractors throughout the SDLC」。§2.2 列举的实例包括「Insiders working on behalf of a system integrator」。完整性方面的对应做法是「code authentication mechanisms, such as digital signatures」与「SBOMs should be digitally signed using a verifiable and trusted key」。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh: 现行版本是 NIST SP 800-161r1-upd1，封面标注「May 2022 INCLUDES UPDATES AS OF 11-01-2024; SEE APPENDIX K」，发布历史记录经 NIST 编辑评审委员会于 2024 年 9 月 25 日批准，并明确「Supersedes NIST Special Publication 800-161r1 (May 2022)」。作者团队包括 Boyens、Smith、Bartol、Winkler、Holbrook 与 Fallon。
statement.en: Registered period: The Frontier.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
